notes.title: Room Movement + Zombie Respawn Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Fixed two critical bugs:

Room Movement - allowing players to move in physical space and have it track to VR, not just the hands. Fixed character controller to move with head/body so walking to edges works correctly.

Zombie Respawn - Zombies were respawning incorrectly if shot on when down. This is now fixed but using their health variable as a limiter.

notes.title: Price: Free
notes.notes:
Zombie Season will be free from the 7th of April.

The reason for this is lack of players, and lack of feedback. 

I feel that by both being in early access and charging a price has reduced the sales of Zombie Season significantly, and therefore also reduced the audience. 

This has resulted in a lack of player feedback and this is what I need the most.

To solve this I'm making the game free from the 7th of April.

Thank you immensely to those of you who have purchased the game.

notes.title: Open World Update - Cars, Helicopters and more!
notes.notes:
Zombie Season now features an open world

Players are able to roam free, drive cars and fly helicopters!!!

Simply exit the police building after training and explore Pine City.
